description: This file defines enums, structs, and a class related to handling requests in the 'allocd' component of a system, including request types, interface types, request statuses, request message format, and a JSON request parser with error logging.

classes.name: JsonRequestReader
classes.description: A class that wraps libjson's Reader to parse JSON messages and log errors.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Json::Value object, logging errors if parsing fails.
